note: Performance values a sample may carry (sample.performance, keyed by id). Each value is stored with its number, this unit, a method and a status; any may be missing. direction: course = across the fabric, along the courses; wale = lengthwise, along the wales. tag_key is the short key on the NFC tag (docs/TAG_FORMAT.md). Our wording. Proposals awaiting review; the fixed loads and conditions are for the lab to set.

terms.label: opacity
terms.definition: Share of light from a set source that the fabric blocks.

terms.label: areal density
terms.definition: Mass of one square metre of fabric.

terms.label: thickness
terms.definition: Distance between the faces under a light set pressure.

terms.label: wales per cm
terms.definition: Wales counted along 1 cm of a course, relaxed.

terms.label: courses per cm
terms.definition: Courses counted along 1 cm of a wale, relaxed.

terms.label: stretch, course
terms.definition: Extension at a fixed load across the fabric, as % of the start length.

terms.label: stretch, wale
terms.definition: Extension at a fixed load along the fabric, as % of the start length.

terms.label: recovery, course
terms.definition: Share of the course stretch taken back after the load is released.

terms.label: recovery, wale
terms.definition: Share of the wale stretch taken back after the load is released.

terms.label: bursting strength
terms.definition: Pressure at which a clamped circle of fabric bursts.

terms.label: tensile strength, course
terms.definition: Highest force a 50 mm wide strip takes across the fabric before it breaks.

terms.label: tensile strength, wale
terms.definition: Highest force a 50 mm wide strip takes along the fabric before it breaks.

terms.label: air permeability
terms.definition: Speed of air passing through the fabric at a set pressure difference.

terms.label: bending length, course
terms.definition: How far a strip cut across the fabric overhangs before it bends to a set angle. Longer is stiffer.

terms.label: bending length, wale
terms.definition: The same for a strip cut along the fabric.

terms.label: abrasion resistance
terms.definition: Rubbing cycles until the fabric breaks down.
